plugins.name: web-search
plugins.description: Keyless multi-engine web search, clean-Markdown fetch, and paginated read for AI agents, plus arxiv and github lookup. Bundles a portable SKILL, a FastMCP stdio server, and a doctor that self-tests every engine and the optional proxy, VPN, and SearXNG layers. Needs internet; no API keys.
